subject: Peregrine Therapeutics — MSA & Order Form kickoff
messages:
From: Lauren Hale <lauren.hale@peregrine.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@peregrine.com, Tom Erickson <terickson@peregrine.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood MSA/order form — kickoff and timelines

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency numbers. We're ready to move forward with your MSA + order form for the pilot. I've attached our initial mark-up of the MSA (Peregrine_MSA_v1_redlines.docx) and a signer matrix stub.

A few asks up front so we can align internal approvals:
- Can you confirm Redwood's standard IP/data residency language (we're in California) and whether you support a fixed-term pilot (3 months) with a cap on tokens?
- We'll need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short hitlist of where audit logs are stored for our security team.
- Our procurement lead needs an expected contracting timeline (initial redline review -> legal counter -> procurement approval -> signature).

Target: have counters and an agreed signing plan by end of next week (Feb 1). If that timeline looks tight, please advise.

Thanks — looping Tom (legal) and our procurement inbox.

Best,
Lauren Hale
Sr. Procurement Manager
Peregrine Therapeutics

Attachments: Peregrine_MSA_v1_redlines.docx (Word, 92KB), Peregrine_Signer_Matrix.xlsx (Excel, 14KB)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Lauren Hale <lauren.hale@peregrine.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 11:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA/order form — kickoff and timelines

Hi Lauren — welcome aboard, excited to get this moving. Quick responses inline and next steps below.

On the asks:
- IP/residency: Redwood's standard MSA includes the usual customer data/residency carve-outs. For pilots we can accommodate a California residency clarification in Exhibit D; Marissa (legal) will confirm specific clause language.
- SOC 2: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II report and a one-page evidence summary for your security team. Vanessa will attach the evidence packet.
- Timeline: suggested plan below (conservative):
   1) Redwood legal initial pass on your redlines — 2 business days
   2) Shared counter (tracked redline) — 1 business day
   3) Procurement & legal review on your side — 3 business days
   4) Final signature/DocuSign — 1 business day

If we start review today, your Feb 1 target is achievable but tight; we'll prioritize.

Deliverables we'll share:
- Tracked redline of MSA and order form (Marissa)
- Signer matrix verification (Vanessa)
- SOC 2 + evidence summary (Vanessa)

Action items for Peregrine:
- Confirm primary signatory and billing contact in the matrix (Tom's details look good but we need a billing email).
- Confirm pilot seat count and token cap so we can populate order form pricing.

I'll pick this up with legal now. Thanks —

Kimmie Park
Head of Contracts Operations
Redwood Inference

On Thu, Jan 22, 2026 at 09:07 AM Lauren Hale <lauren.hale@peregrine.com> wrote:

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Jan 2026 08:16:00 -08:00
Subject: Redwood legal — initial redline notes (Peregrine_MSA_v1)

Team — I completed the first pass on Peregrine's mark-up and summarized the substantive asks below. I attached a tracked redline (we will send a clean counter to them once we align on a few items).

Top items:
1) Indemnity: Peregrine removed our limitation of liability language and proposed a mutual expanded indemnity. Recommend: propose wording that narrows to third-party IP claims and remove open-ended operational indemnities.
2) Data residency/processing: They requested an explicit California residency guarantee for the pilot. We can add Exhibit D language that states primary processing in US (with data replicated in region X) — confirm with infra.
3) Pilot termination: they want an unilateral termination for convenience after 30 days with no penalties. Recommend limiting to a 30-day termination with pro-rata billing and retention obligations.
4) Audit & SOC: they requested on-site audits. We'll offer SOC 2 Type II and a table of evidence; on-site only for enterprise (not for pilot).

Risk calls for kimberly/vanessa: if they insist on on-site audits or removing liability caps, we should elevate to legal leadership / Sales leadership.

Proposed next step: Vanessa to assemble the evidence packet; Kimberly to confirm signer and billing contact; Dev to confirm pricing and token cap for the order form. I will prepare tracked redline and suggested language for indemnity + termination by end of day.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_counter_Peregrine_MSA_redline.docx (tracked, 48KB)
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Lauren Hale <lauren.hale@peregrine.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Jan 2026 15:43:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA/order form — kickoff and timelines

Hi Lauren — thanks for the materials and patience. Attaching the evidence packet and our counter for the MSA (see attachments). Quick summary and a couple of asks from procurement side:

Summary:
- Counter sent with clarified indemnity language (mutual, IP-limited) and a pilot-specific Exhibit D for residency.
- SOC 2 Type II report + evidence sheet attached. We are not offering on-site audits for pilots; we can revisit for enterprise deals.
- Order form: Dev, see the token cap options I added to the pricing table; confirm which tier Peregrine prefers.

Requests for Peregrine:
- Please confirm the signer in the matrix and fill billing contact (email). We cannot proceed to DocuSign until the matrix is complete.
- Confirm pilot seat count and token cap option by EOD Tue Jan 27 so we can hit their Feb 1 target.

Lauren — if you want, we can do a 20-minute sync on Monday to walk procurement through the evidence packet and the redlines.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Contracts Program Manager
Redwood Inference
